Datasheet
AXISM5000-G
AXISM5000-GPTZCamera
Situational awareness camera with build-in PTZ and Z-Wave®
AXIS M5000-G PTZ Camera features three 5 MP sensors and one PTZ camera with 10x optical zoom for total situational
awareness of indoor areas up to 400 m2 (4300 ft2). With everything displayed on one monitor, you can move from
overview to detailed views in a single click. It offers wireless I/O connectivity with Z-Wave Plus® devices to
communicate with up to six devices in a system setup for instance monitor temperatures in freezers or turn lights on/
off. With AXIS M5000-G, you get the benefits of four cameras while installing just one camera.
